scripts.docs:dev: cd docs && pnpm dlx mint@4.2.873 dev --port 3001
scripts.docs:check: cd docs && pnpm dlx mint@4.2.873 validate && pnpm dlx mint@4.2.873 broken-links
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run knip && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run

scripts.test:research:review: pnpm run build && RUN_RESEARCH_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 node --env-file-if-exists=.env.research.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run apps/demo/test/research.live.test.ts
